Components.Name: SceneAxes
Components.Description: The three axes of a view: how a world stands to the eye; a press on one tells which.

Props.Name: Yaw
Props.Description: The turn of the view round the height, in radians.

Props.Name: Pitch
Props.Description: How far above its middle the eye stands, in radians.

Props.Name: Size
Props.Description: Its side in pixels.

Props.Name: Labels
Props.Description: Writes the letters of the axes.

Props.Name: Label
Props.Description: The name of it for screen readers.

EventDescriptions.axis: An end of an axis was pressed: {Axis, Sign}.

Components.Name: BlueprintPreview
Components.Description: What a graph of Blueprints that makes a thing of data gives (a cloud of points, a network, a layout, a picture), drawn flat as it is changed.

Props.Name: Graph
Props.Description: The graph: an object, its JSON, or the name of a resource (ElemenxGraphics/cloud/sky).

Props.Name: Parameters
Props.Description: What the graph is run with: {key: value}.

Props.Name: Inputs
Props.Description: What a network graph is given: {name: value} of its Input blocks; empty, a sample of each (NetworkBlueprints.Sample).

Props.Name: Turn
Props.Description: How far it is turned round its height, in radians.

Props.Name: Pitch
Props.Description: How far it is seen from over it, in radians.

Props.Name: Height
Props.Description: Its height in pixels.

Props.Name: Label
Props.Description: Its name for screen readers.

Components.Name: SceneMark
Components.Description: What it holds over a place of the scene, laid out each frame with the other marks: off each other, hidden behind bodies, at the edge with an arrow.

Props.Name: Key
Props.Description: Its name among the marks (its own one else).

Props.Name: For
Props.Description: The ID of the object it stands over.

Props.Name: Part
Props.Description: A socket of the model of that object (by Name or ID).

Props.Name: Point
Props.Description: A point of the world [x, y, z] (with no For).

Props.Name: Up
Props.Description: How many sizes of the object over its middle (1.15).

Props.Name: Offset
Props.Description: Added to the point, [x, y, z].

Props.Name: Shift
Props.Description: Moved on the screen, [x, y] pixels.

Props.Name: Align
Props.Description: What of it stands on the point.

Props.Name: Line
Props.Description: A line from the point to it: always, when it was moved (auto) or never.

Props.Name: Occlude
Props.Description: Hidden behind bodies and the ground (true for an object).

Props.Name: Edge
Props.Description: At the edge of the view with an arrow when its place is off it.

Props.Name: Declutter
Props.Description: Moved off the marks before it (true).

Props.Name: Cluster
Props.Description: A name: marks of it near each other show as one with a badge +N.

Props.Name: ClusterRadius
Props.Description: How near, in pixels (36).

Props.Name: Near
Props.Description: Fully seen nearer than this, in metres.

Props.Name: Far
Props.Description: Gone this far, in metres (0: never).

Props.Name: Priority
Props.Description: Laid out before those of less (0).

Components.Name: ViewActions
Components.Description: The actions of the view of an editor in a bar over its bottom; a toggle gives one finger to the camera.

Props.Name: Items
Props.Description: The actions: [{ID, Icon, Label, Disabled, Danger}].

Props.Name: Hand
Props.Description: One finger moves the camera (true or false); null leaves the toggle out.

Props.Name: Label
Props.Description: The name of the bar for screen readers.

EventDescriptions.hand: The toggle of one finger for the camera: {Hand}.

Components.Name: SceneObject
Components.Description: An object of a game of any kind: its Kind gives its traits and parts, every other attribute is a field of it.

Props.Name: ID
Props.Description: The ID of the object.

Props.Name: Kind
Props.Description: Its kind (the Kinds Service): planet, station, fleet, tree, or one of your own.

Props.Name: Name
Props.Description: Its name.

Props.Name: Part
Props.Description: The part of its parent it changes (the part of that ID of the kind of the parent).

Props.Name: Parent
Props.Description: What it goes round or belongs to, when not the object it is declared in.

Props.Name: Team
Props.Description: Its team.

Props.Name: X
Props.Description: Its place across (a cell of a map).

Props.Name: Y
Props.Description: Its place down (a cell of a map).

Props.Name: Width
Props.Description: The cells it takes across.

Props.Name: Height
Props.Description: The cells it takes down.

Props.Name: Color
Props.Description: Its color.

Props.Name: Image
Props.Description: A picture of it, standing on its cell.

Props.Name: Blocks
Props.Description: No way through it.

Props.Name: Opaque
Props.Description: It hides what is behind it.

Components.Name: Scene
Components.Description: The scene of a game in 3D: objects of any kind with their traits and parts; the setting space brings a star system on Kepler orbits, stations and fleets, with a landing on the surfaces of its bodies; the setting terrain a ground of noise and its walkers.

Props.Name: Setting
Props.Description: The setting: its kinds and systems (space: a star system; terrain: a ground and its walkers; galaxy: a galaxy of Galaxy, SceneGalaxy; universe: the galaxies of Universe, SceneUniverse).

Props.Name: Galaxy
Props.Description: The galaxy of Setting galaxy (SceneGalaxy, GalaxyData): a key of GalaxyData.Use, the URL of its file, its data, or options of GalaxyData.Make ({Seed, Kind, Radius, Arms}).

Props.Name: Universe
Props.Description: The universe of Setting universe (SceneUniverse, UniverseData): a key of UniverseData.Use, the URL of its file, its data, or options of UniverseData.Make ({Seed, Galaxies, Home}); the systems of its galaxies see the galaxies round them in their skies.

Props.Name: GalaxyTime
Props.Description: The time of the galaxy in millions of years: it turns as a galaxy turns, the inner stars sooner than the outer ones.

Props.Name: System
Props.Description: The objects: {Objects: [{ID, Kind, Parent, Values, Traits, Parts, Children}]}, or a system of data (SystemData): {Data: the URL of its file, or a key of SystemData.Use}.

Props.Name: Seed
Props.Description: A whole star system made of a seed (always the same for the same seed).

Props.Name: Systems
Props.Description: Systems of the application for traits of its own: {Trait: {Update(object, scene), Draw(object, scene)}}.

Props.Name: Time
Props.Description: The day of the scene.

Props.Name: Speed
Props.Description: The days of the scene a second.

Props.Name: Capture
Props.Description: With a walker under the keys (Control), a press takes the pointer: the mouse turns the view, Escape gives it back.

Props.Name: Person
Props.Description: Where the view of a walker stands: behind it (third), in its eyes (first, its head hidden but its body and what it holds seen) or over its shoulder. V changes it while the pointer is taken.

Props.Name: Cutaway
Props.Description: While a walker is inside a ship standing (SceneAboard), its hull and its ceilings are not drawn and the view looks in from over it, as at a house cut open; off, the hull stays round it, the view within its rooms.

Props.Name: Shoulder
Props.Description: Over which shoulder the view stands. B changes it while the pointer is taken.

Props.Name: Axes
Props.Description: The corner where the Axes of the view stand, none when empty; a press on one looks along it.

Props.Name: Origin
Props.Description: Draws the three axes of the world at its middle (and the colliders as their outlines).

Props.Name: Wireframe
Props.Description: Draws the wire of the scene over it: each edge of the ground and of the models (--elemenx-scene-wire).

Props.Name: Levels
Props.Description: Colors each thing by the level of detail it is drawn at (near green to red, the proxies of far tiles cyan to pink, the squares of the ground by their depth), with the draws and triangles of a frame in a corner: to see where the detail goes. Ctrl+Shift+L turns it on and off.

Props.Name: Proxies
Props.Description: Far tiles of what is sown drawn each as one simpler shape (SceneProxies), as Voxy draws a far land; false: each thing by its own levels.

Props.Name: Clusters
Props.Description: Large models that stand alone (3000 faces or more) drawn by their clusters (SceneClusters, as Nanite): each part as fine as the screen needs; false: each at its finest.

Props.Name: CacheSize
Props.Description: Megabytes the browser keeps of what the scene made (SceneCache: the proxies of far tiles), the oldest gone over it; 0 keeps nothing.

Props.Name: Edges
Props.Description: Draws the edges of the models: where their faces meet at an angle and their rims (--elemenx-scene-edges).

Props.Name: Hovered
Props.Description: The ID of the object under the pointer, outlined (--elemenx-scene-hover) as the selected one is (--elemenx-scene-outline).

Props.Name: HoverMark
Props.Description: How the object under the pointer is marked: none (the default: the hover event alone), ring, outline, or {Look, Color (#rrggbb), Width (pixels of an outline), Pulse (seconds of a beat, 0 still), Cursor (a CSS cursor over it)}.

Props.Name: SelectMark
Props.Description: How the selected object is marked: outline (the default, with a ring while it is small on the screen), ring, none, or {Look, Color, Width, Pulse}.

Props.Name: HoverCheck
Props.Description: A function (object, info) for what the pointer may mark: false passes it by, an object of the fields of HoverMark marks it so; without it all may be but the walker or the vehicle under the keys.

Props.Name: SelectCheck
Props.Description: A function (object, info) for what a press (on it or on its label) may select: false passes it by. Select(id) from code is not asked.

Props.Name: Orders
Props.Description: A right press on the ground sends the walker selected there (a game of its own, as GameStrategy, orders as it likes).

Props.Name: FreeLook
Props.Description: A walker that stands does not turn with the view, so it can be looked at from all sides: it comes round when it sets off.

Props.Name: DaySeconds
Props.Description: The seconds a day of 24 hours takes, on a body and from space alike, however fast the orbits go (0: as Speed says).

Props.Name: SurfaceSpeed
Props.Description: The days a second on the surface of a body (1/120: a day of two minutes).

Props.Name: PlantStyle
Props.Description: How its plants look: realistic (SceneFlora: grown trees, their bark and leaves drawn, the default) or simple (the models of code of few faces).

Props.Name: Shadows
Props.Description: The shadows of a sun on a ground, a surface and a model near the view (true).

Props.Name: Compute
Props.Description: How its grounds compute their heights: auto and wasm by WebAssembly where it is made (the very same numbers, faster), js by JavaScript alone.

Props.Name: Quality
Props.Description: What the light costs: empty chooses by the graphics card and steps down while frames are late.

Props.Name: Pipeline
Props.Description: The render graph of the Blueprints Service that makes the picture of a frame (high, ultra and medium): its passes (Scene, Clouds, Occlusion, Air, Frames, Mirror, Rays, Exposure, Bokeh, Bloom, Picture, Shader: a pass graph of its own) up to Present; empty: PipelineGraph(), the passes of the library.

Props.Name: PipelineParameters
Props.Description: The values of the parameters of the Pipeline, by key.

Props.Name: Flare
Props.Description: How strongly the rings and the glow a lens makes of the sun show, at high and ultra: 0 to 2 (true is 1).

Props.Name: Weather
Props.Description: What the air of a ground does; it changes in a few seconds, as a front comes; changing goes from one to the next by itself.

Props.Name: Wind
Props.Description: How strong the wind is, 0 to 4, for clouds, rain, grass and trees (empty: as the weather has it).

Props.Name: WindWay
Props.Description: Where the wind blows to: an azimuth in degrees.

Props.Name: WaterGraph
Props.Description: What water looks like: a water graph of the Blueprints Service (or its JSON, or its GLSL) of its waves, the sky and the sun it mirrors, its depth, its foam and the fog over it; the one of the library (LibraryWater) when empty.

Props.Name: LandGraph
Props.Description: What the land is, its light and its wet and snow too: a land graph of the Blueprints Service (or its JSON, or GLSL with blueprintLand); empty, the one of the library (LibraryLand()). Its Blueprint (a material graph) still paints it, in LandPaint.

Props.Name: Graphs
Props.Description: The shader graphs of a world of its own by their names, the scene made again in place when one is given anew (its objects, its view and its time kept; behind a soft veil while its programs are made): shader/bake (BakeGraph), shader/weather (WeatherGraph), shader/bolt (BoltGraph), shader/air (AirGraph), shader/clouds (CloudsGraph), shader/forecast (ForecastGraph), shader/galaxy (GalaxyGraph), shader/cosmos (CosmosGraph), shader/ring (RingGraph), shader/planet (PlanetGraph), shader/ground (GroundGraph), planet/envelope (EnvelopeGraph), star (the stars with no Blueprint of their own: their surface, crown, beams and numbers); its props of them come first.

Props.Name: BoltGraph
Props.Description: The shape of its lightnings, of a storm and of its effects: a generator of the Blueprints Service of the jag of each step (its results X and Z; or its JSON); empty, the one of the library (SceneBlueprints.LibraryBolt()).

Props.Name: PlanetGraph
Props.Description: Its globes seen from far: a planet graph of the Blueprints Service of their picture lit, their clouds and the shadows of them and of a ring, their towns at night, their air at the edge (or its JSON, or GLSL with blueprintPlanet); empty, the one of the library (LibraryPlanet()).

Props.Name: EnvelopeGraph
Props.Description: What lies over and under the surface of its bodies (their air, decks of clouds, seas, the depths of a giant): a generator of numbers of the Blueprints Service of the blocks EnvelopeState and EnvelopeLight of the Envelope Service (its results Pressure, Temperature, Zone and Light; or its JSON); empty, the one of the library (LibraryEnvelope()).

Props.Name: GroundGraph
Props.Description: The ground of its globes near and from over them: a ground graph of the Blueprints Service of its picture, its woods, fields, snow and dunes, its relief, the tiles near, the shadows of its clouds and of a ring, its water, towns at night, clouds from over them and air (or its JSON, or GLSL with blueprintGround); empty, the one of the library (LibraryGround()).

Props.Name: GroundFarGraph
Props.Description: How a texel of the picture of the far ground of its planets looks (a generator graph of numbers, or the name of one: blueprints/shader/ground-far, of its land, sea, slope, warmth, wet, deserts, fields, houses, a river and a highway: R, G, B, Water, Trees, Farm, Built, Dune, Snow); empty, Graphs of shader/ground-far, else the one of the library. Made code in the page, it paints the planet in its workers.

Props.Name: SkyLightGraph
Props.Description: The light of the sky on all it lights and mirrors (a generator graph of numbers: blueprints/shader/sky-light, of WayY, SunDot, SunY, Spread, SkyR/G/B, FloorR/G/B, Gain: R, G, B): the sea, glass, the paint of a car, the objects, the grass, the land and the probes; empty, Graphs of shader/sky-light, else the one of the library. Read as the scene is made.

Props.Name: RingGraph
Props.Description: The rings round its bodies: a ring graph of the Blueprints Service of their bands, gaps, colors and light (or its JSON, or GLSL with blueprintRing); empty, the one of the library (LibraryRing()).

Props.Name: CosmosGraph
Props.Description: What lies far behind a system, the sky its Cosmos is baked of: a cosmos graph of the Blueprints Service of its parts (gas, dust, the band of a galaxy, bursts, galaxies far off, pillars, stars, clusters; or its JSON, or GLSL with blueprintCosmos); empty, the one of the library (LibraryCosmos()).

Props.Name: GalaxyGraph
Props.Description: The arms of a galaxy, its picture, its stars and the band of it across the sky of a system alike: a generator of the Blueprints Service of the blocks of GalaxyData (its results Turn, Bend, Wave and Arm; or its JSON); empty, the one of the library (SceneBlueprints.LibraryGalaxy()).

Props.Name: ReactorGraph
Props.Description: A step of a reactor of the systems of an object (SceneShipSystems): Heat, Tripped, Supply of Heat, Load, Rise, Cool, Elapsed, On, Tripped, Trip, Resume, Output; empty, the one of the library (blueprints/vehicles/reactor); of the Power of an object wins.

Props.Name: PowerGraph
Props.Description: What the power of the reactors gives each system (SceneShipSystems): Engines, Shields, Weapons, Load of Supply, the needs and the shares of each; empty, the one of the library (blueprints/vehicles/power).

Props.Name: ShieldGraph
Props.Description: A step of a layer of a shield (SceneShipSystems): Value of Value, Capacity, Regen, Power, Since, Delay, Elapsed; empty, the one of the library (blueprints/vehicles/shield).

Props.Name: ShipButtons
Props.Description: Its own buttons of the commands of a ship (Landing, Take off, To orbit) over the view; false: none, the commands given by a game (ShipCommands, ShipCommand: on its consoles, its panels).

Props.Name: MassLock
Props.Description: Ships near ships of another team go no faster than a fight goes, by the frame of their fight (the soft mass lock: MassLockGraph); off by default.

Props.Name: MassLockGraph
Props.Description: How fast a ship may go near ships of another team (Distance, Top -> Top, Lock): a generator graph of the Blueprints Service (or its JSON); empty, the one of the library (blueprints/vehicles/masslock).

Props.Name: StarsGraph
Props.Description: The stars round the eye in space (Seed, Count, Power, Scale, Low, Radius -> Position, Color): a cloud graph of the Blueprints Service (CloudBlueprints; or its JSON); empty, Graphs of cloud/sky, else the one of the library (blueprints/cloud/sky).

Props.Name: NightGraph
Props.Description: The stars of the night of a ground (Seed, Count, Power, Scale, Low, Radius -> Position, Color): a cloud graph of the Blueprints Service (CloudBlueprints; or its JSON); empty, Graphs of cloud/night, else the one of the library (blueprints/cloud/night).

Props.Name: BoardGraph
Props.Description: How one gets into a vehicle and out of it step by step (Kind, Height, Door -> Open, Enter, Sit, Close: seconds; Clip, Duck): a generator graph of the Blueprints Service (or its JSON); empty, the one of the library (blueprints/vehicles/board).

Props.Name: ReadoutGraph
Props.Description: What the instruments of a vehicle or of a character on foot read (Speed, TopSpeed, SpeedPart, RpmPart, Gear, Left, Right, Lights, HealthPart of Forward, Top, Rpm, Redline, Gear, Indicate, Hazard, Blink, Lights, Health, MaxHealth): a generator graph of the Blueprints Service (or its JSON); empty, the one of the library (blueprints/vehicles/readout); ReadoutGraph of a vehicle wins.

Props.Name: DrivesGraph
Props.Description: What each moving part, lamp, emitter and pop of a vehicle is driven to of its state (steer, gas, wipers, stroke, lamp-brake... of Steer, Gas, Swept, Stroke...): a generator graph of the Blueprints Service (or its JSON); empty, the one of the library (blueprints/vehicles/drives); DrivesGraph of a vehicle wins.

Props.Name: WheelGraph
Props.Description: How each wheel of a car turns of its state (SpinAngle, SteerAngle, Drop, Camber of Spin, Steer, Stroke, Size, Front, Held, Side): a generator graph of the Blueprints Service (or its JSON); empty, the one of the library (blueprints/vehicles/wheel); WheelGraph of a vehicle wins.

Props.Name: ThrustGraph
Props.Description: How what burns on an engine looks of its thrust (Length, Intensity, Inside of Thrust): a generator graph of the Blueprints Service (or its JSON); empty, the one of the library (blueprints/vehicles/thrust); ThrustGraph of a vehicle wins.

Props.Name: LandingLookGraph
Props.Description: How a landing looks as it goes (Heat, Fov, Thrust, Raise, TransferThrust, OrbitThrust, HoverThrust of Thick, Speed, Over, Going, Throttle, Manual, T, Landed, Pull, Flat, Top): a generator graph of the Blueprints Service (or its JSON); empty, the one of the library (blueprints/landing/look).

Props.Name: FeetGraph
Props.Description: How the feet of one of legs keep to the ground (DownLeft, DownRight: metres the ground under each foot is above its own, Size, Speed, Grounded -> Drop: its hips down, Left, Right: each foot up or down, Rate): a generator graph of the Blueprints Service (or its JSON); empty, the one of the library (blueprints/animation/feet).

Props.Name: BlendGraph
Props.Description: Which gaits a model goes in at a speed (Speed, Walk, Jog, Sprint: the speeds of its walk, jog and sprint at their own pace -> Low, High: 0 walk, 1 jog, 2 sprint; Weight of the high one, blended as one cycle): a generator graph of the Blueprints Service (or its JSON); empty, the one of the library (blueprints/animation/blend). An object of Blend false keeps the gait it is given.

Props.Name: LookbackGraph
Props.Description: What the weather of hours ago left on the ground, a step of it (Wet, Snow, Warm, Hours, Was -> Wetness, Cover): a generator graph of the Blueprints Service (or its JSON); empty, the one of the library (blueprints/weather/lookback).

Props.Name: LocalWeatherGraph
Props.Description: The weather of a place of a planet of its forecast there (Cover, Kind, Cirrus, Rain, Warm -> Clouds, Kind, High, Wind, Fog, Rain, Snow, Wet, Storm: the numbers of the weather of a scene): a generator graph of the Blueprints Service (or its JSON); empty, the one of the library (blueprints/weather/local).

Props.Name: BodyGraph
Props.Description: How the body of a car leans on its springs (Accel, Lateral: m/s², Stiff, Grounded -> Pitch, Roll radians, Spring, Damp): a generator graph of the Blueprints Service (or its JSON); empty, BodyGraph of the vehicle, else the one of the library (blueprints/vehicles/body).

Props.Name: BankGraph
Props.Description: How a ship banks into a turn (Turn: rad/s, Speed, Top, Air, Landed -> Roll radians, View: the share of it every view banks with, Spring, Damp): a generator graph of the Blueprints Service (or its JSON); empty, BankGraph of the vehicle, else the one of the library (blueprints/vehicles/bank).

Props.Name: TransitionGraph
Props.Description: How a clip of a model gives way to the next (FromKnown, FromGait, ToGait, FromOnce, ToOnce, ToHold -> Fade: seconds, Ease: 1 eased, Sync: 1 the next goes on from the phase of the last, its steps in time): a generator graph of the Blueprints Service (or its JSON); empty, Transition of the recipe of the model, else the one of the library (blueprints/animation/transition).

Props.Name: ShakeGraph
Props.Description: How a view shakes (X, Y, Z, Pitch, Yaw, Roll of a rig; HeatRight, HeatUp; KickTaken; TraumaPitch, TraumaYaw, TraumaRoll, BlastLeft; WarpRight, WarpUp of Time, Seed, Shake, Hover, Walked, Stride, Heat, Size, Kick, Elapsed, Blast, Rpm, Jolt, Warp): a generator graph of the Blueprints Service (or its JSON); empty, the one of the library (blueprints/camera/shake).

Props.Name: TravelLookGraph
Props.Description: How a warp and a jump look in each of their phases (Stretch, Tunnel, Flash, Shake, Wide, Lag, Pace of the Phase: 0 into it, 1 in it, 2 out of it; Warp: 1 a warp, 0 a jump; T of the phase; Time in it): a generator graph of the Blueprints Service (or its JSON); empty, the one of the library (blueprints/vehicles/travel-look).

Props.Name: SeasonGraph
Props.Description: The season of the sun and what it does to plants and the land (Warmth, Rising, Bare, Turn, Blossom, Dry, Snow of its Fixed season, Latitude, YearDays and DayOfYear): a generator graph of the Blueprints Service (or its JSON); empty, the one of the library (blueprints/weather/season).

Props.Name: ForecastGraph
Props.Description: The weather of a planet, its clouds, cirrus and rain over its body as its days go: a graph of numbers of the Blueprints Service of the blocks of SceneForecast (or its JSON), read by its shader and the page alike; empty, the one of the library (LibraryForecast()).

Props.Name: CloudsGraph
Props.Description: The clouds (of the weather of a planet, its globe and round the eye over it, the layer of a scene): a clouds graph of the Blueprints Service (or its JSON); empty, the one of the library (LibraryClouds()).

Props.Name: AirGraph
Props.Description: The air between the eye and what it sees (the haze, the fog, the eye under the sea): an air graph of the Blueprints Service (or its JSON); empty, the one of the library (LibraryAir()).

Props.Name: WeatherGraph
Props.Description: What the weather and the year do to the surfaces of things (their leaves in autumn, snow, pools, a beam that takes a body away): a weather graph of the Blueprints Service (or its JSON); empty, the one of the library (LibraryWeather()).

Props.Name: BakeGraph
Props.Description: What the surface of a body of noise is, baked into its cubes (its land read by its ground too): a bake graph of the Blueprints Service (or its JSON, or GLSL with blueprintBake); empty, the one of the library (LibraryBake()).

Props.Name: SkyGraph
Props.Description: What the sky is: a sky graph of the Blueprints Service (or its JSON, or GLSL with blueprintSky); empty, the one of the library (LibrarySky()).

Props.Name: GrassGraph
Props.Description: How the wind leans the grass: a vertex graph as WindGraph (or its JSON, or GLSL); empty, the one of the library (LibraryGrass()).

Props.Name: WindGraph
Props.Description: How the wind bends what grows and sways: a vertex graph of the Blueprints Service (or its JSON, or its GLSL), the one of the library (LibraryWind) when empty; the Vertex of a material runs after it.

Props.Name: Front
Props.Description: The seconds a change of the weather takes.

Props.Name: View
Props.Description: A ground seen in parallel rays, as a game of two dimensions: from above or at an angle (empty: in perspective).

Props.Name: Paused
Props.Description: Holds the time.

Props.Name: Loader
Props.Description: Shows how much of the scene has come; a slot named loading takes its place.

Props.Name: Focus
Props.Description: The ID of the object in the middle of the view.

Props.Name: Selected
Props.Description: The ID of the selected object.

Props.Name: Orbits
Props.Description: Draws the orbits.

Props.Name: Labels
Props.Description: Shows the names of the objects.

Props.Name: Exposure
Props.Description: What a view lets in: a number holds it, empty adapts to the light as an eye does.

Props.Name: Aurora
Props.Description: The northern lights, 0 to 1 (more is brighter): anywhere, at night; empty: by themselves at 55 to 68 degrees of Latitude of the sun, at night under a clear sky.

Props.Name: AuroraColors
Props.Description: The colors of the northern lights, under and over: ['#3dff9a', '#c03cff'].

Props.Name: Crosshair
Props.Description: The crosshair over the view while the hero holds a Weapon: empty as its weapon says, none for no crosshair.

Props.Name: MarkCount
Props.Description: How many marks of shots stay at once (the oldest go first).

Props.Name: MarkSeconds
Props.Description: How long a mark of a shot stays, in seconds.

Props.Name: Season
Props.Description: The season the land and its plants show: spring, summer, autumn or winter; empty: of the sun (its DayOfYear of YearDays at its Latitude), passing with the days.

Props.Name: Rainbow
Props.Description: A rainbow, 0 to 1, where the sun stands low behind the view; empty: the weather's, in a light rain or as it ends.

Props.Name: Cutscenes
Props.Description: The cutscenes of the scene by name ({Name: {Tracks, Restore, Skip, Loop}}, SceneCinema): PlayCutscene(name) plays one; Save and Load keep them.

Props.Name: Camera
Props.Description: The camera of the scene (an object of kind camera) that shows the world; empty: the view of the scene.

Props.Name: Bokeh
Props.Description: The depth of field, 0 to 1: how wide the lens is open; what is far from the focus is blurred, a bright point of it a disc.

Props.Name: BokehFocus
Props.Description: The distance in focus; empty: the hero, or what the middle of the view shows, followed slowly.

Props.Name: Details
Props.Description: Shows a card of the selected object.

Props.Name: Background
Props.Description: Draws the stars far away.

Props.Name: Cosmos
Props.Description: What lies far behind a system, made of a seed: nebula, pillars, galaxy, galaxies, cluster, void, or {Kind, Seed, Colors, Gas, Dust, Stars, Pillars, Band, Galaxies, Clusters, Beacon}: a kind is a set of these amounts, and what is told comes on top of it.

Props.Name: Scale
Props.Description: Large bodies and short distances (compressed), or their real sizes, or a number between them: 0 compressed to 1 real (a slider, as their ratio goes).

Props.Name: Team
Props.Description: The team of the player.

Props.Name: Label
Props.Description: The name of the scene for screen readers.

EventDescriptions.ready: The scene is ready: the component itself, to call its methods.
EventDescriptions.gesture: A gesture of fingers on it (Gestures: tap, doubletap, press, pan, swipe, pinch, rotate, tilt), after the scene did its part: {Gesture, ID (what is under it; tap, doubletap and press), Point {X, Y} (in the scene)}.
EventDescriptions.select: The selection changed: {ID, Object, Info, IDs, Objects} (ID empty when none is).
EventDescriptions.focus: The view moved to an object: {ID}.
EventDescriptions.person: V took the view of a walker to another place: third, first or shoulder.
EventDescriptions.loading: What the scene waits for came a step nearer: {Part (up to 100, never back), Stage (programs, models, sky, galaxy, nebulae, rivers, globes, surface, ground, plants, view; empty when done), Stages ([{Name, Label, Done, Total}] of those it has)}.
EventDescriptions.prepared: All the view needs is made and the veil goes: {First (the start of the scene, not a location that came)}.
EventDescriptions.shield: A layer of the shield of an object took a hit (SceneShipSystems): {ID, Layer, Value, Capacity, Taken, Broken, Hit}.
EventDescriptions.discover: A place came within the sensors of a vehicle and is known now (SceneShipSystems, NavPoint): {ID, By, Kind, Name}.
EventDescriptions.context: An actor (the character of the player) sat in a seat of a vehicle or left it (SceneVehicles Board, Leave, BoardKey: G): {Actor, Kind (walk or seat), Vehicle, Seat, Role, Controls}.
EventDescriptions.agent: An agent (SceneAgents: Values.Agent, a tree of behaviour) began a task: {ID, Task, Enemy}.
EventDescriptions.autopilot: The autopilot of a ship took it, brought it there, or let it go (SceneVehicles Autopilot): {ID, Mode (hold, approach, follow), Phase (on, arrived, off), Reason (hand, asked, target)}.
EventDescriptions.eva: A step of going out of a ship in space and in again (SceneAboard: G by its airlock): {Actor, Vehicle, Step (cycle, out, in), Out}.
EventDescriptions.boarding: A step of getting in or out of a vehicle step by step (Board and Leave with Animate, G by a car): {Actor, Vehicle, Seat, Step (approach, open, enter, sit, exit, close, done), Out}.
EventDescriptions.influence: An influence on the weather of a planet began (Influence): {ID, Kind, Body, Direction, Radius, Start, Length, Strength}.
EventDescriptions.ground: A ground came, its field made (a ground of the scene, of a location, of a planet landed on): {Key (its shape: location:<id>:<model> for a location), ID (the object it is of), Location (true for a location)}.
EventDescriptions.shoulder: B took the view over another shoulder: right or left.
EventDescriptions.arrive: An object reached where it was sent: {ID, At}.
EventDescriptions.land: The view went down to the surface of a body: {ID}.
EventDescriptions.takeoff: The view went back up to space: {ID}.
EventDescriptions.travel: A ship on its way far at once (Travel, H or J) came to a phase: {ID, Kind (warp or jump), Phase (enter, inside, exit, done)}.
EventDescriptions.enter: The view went into the system of a star of the galaxy (EnterSystem): {ID, Star, Key (of SystemData.Use)}.
EventDescriptions.leave: The view went out of a system to its galaxy (LeaveSystem): {ID}.
EventDescriptions.action: A trigger was sent an action (Action of the trigger): {Trigger, Name, Data}.
EventDescriptions.dig: A hole was dug in the ground (Dig): {At, Radius}.
EventDescriptions.fire: An object shot its weapon (SceneWeapons): {ID, Weapon, From, Way}.
EventDescriptions.hit: A shot hit something or the ground (SceneWeapons): {ID, Weapon, Type, Source, Team, Target, Part, Point, Normal, Material, Amount, Distance}.
EventDescriptions.lock: The hero locked a target under its aim (Lock of its weapon), or its ship with its missiles (SceneMissiles): {ID, Weapon, By}.
EventDescriptions.missile: A missile (SceneMissiles) was launched, taken by a flare, lost its target, was brought down, hit or flew its range: {ID, Weapon, Source, Target, State (launch, decoyed, reacquired, lost, intercepted, hit, spent), By}.
EventDescriptions.flares: A ship released flares: {ID, Count, Left}.
EventDescriptions.charge: A weapon that charges (Charge: the lance) began to: {ID, Weapon, Seconds}.
EventDescriptions.tunnel: A railgun faster than light opened a tunnel of warp for its slug (no warning to the target): {ID, Weapon, Source, Target, Mode (predict, direct), Blocked}.
EventDescriptions.break: A thing broke into pieces (Break, SceneDebris): {ID, Pieces, Point}.
EventDescriptions.teleport: A thing is beamed away or comes (Teleport): {ID, Phase (out or in), From, To}.
EventDescriptions.through: A ship flew into the mouth of a wormhole (SceneDeepSpace): {ID, Wormhole, Leads, To (the mouth it comes out of, empty: none)}.
EventDescriptions.galaxy: A star of the galaxy was picked (Setting galaxy, SceneGalaxy): {ID (empty: none or the black hole), Centre (the black hole), Star}.
EventDescriptions.galaxyready: The galaxy of Galaxy came: {ID, Data}.
EventDescriptions.universe: A galaxy of the universe was picked (Setting universe, SceneUniverse): {ID (empty: none), Galaxy}.
EventDescriptions.universeready: The universe of Universe came: {ID, Data, Home}.
EventDescriptions.entergalaxy: The view went into a galaxy of the universe (EnterGalaxy): {ID, Galaxy, Key (of GalaxyData.Use)}.
EventDescriptions.leavegalaxy: The view went out of a galaxy to its universe (LeaveGalaxy): {ID}.
EventDescriptions.entervoid: The scene stands between the galaxies of its universe, out of a warp on its way (EnterVoid): {Place (Mpc)}.
EventDescriptions.markcluster: A badge +N of a cluster of marks was pressed (Mark, Cluster): {Cluster, Keys}; the view goes to them.
EventDescriptions.hover: The pointer came over a selectable object, or left it: {ID (empty: none), Object, Info}.
EventDescriptions.cutscene: A cutscene started, ended or was stopped (SceneCinema): {Name, State: start, end or stop}.
EventDescriptions.cue: A cue of a cutscene came: {Cutscene, Name, Data, At}.
EventDescriptions.part: A part of an object was set by its role (Part(id, role).Set): {ID, Role, Value}.
EventDescriptions.touch: Two solid things began to touch (trait Rigid): {ID, With (null: the ground), At, Normal, Impulse}.
EventDescriptions.crack: A thing with the trait Fracture was hurt and still holds (SceneFracture): {ID, Integrity, Point, Amount}.
EventDescriptions.shader: A graph (or GLSL written by hand) made into a shader did not compile, and what the library has is drawn in its place: {Kind (material, vertex, land, water, wind, grass, effect, pass), Owner (the material, object or prop of the graph), Errors ([{Block, Line, Message}]: each on the block of GLSL it is in), Message}.

Components.Name: Drawing
Components.Description: A vector drawing: shapes, lines, arrows, freehand brushes and texts on layers, with groups and an export to SVG and PNG.

Props.Name: Value
Props.Description: The model: {Width, Height, Background, Layers: [{ID, Name, Visible, Locked, Items}]}.

Props.Name: Tool
Props.Description: The tool in hand.

Props.Name: Brush
Props.Description: The brush of the freehand tool.

Props.Name: Stroke
Props.Description: The color of the lines of new items.

Props.Name: Fill
Props.Description: The color inside new shapes (none: no fill).

Props.Name: StrokeWidth
Props.Description: The width of the lines in the units of the drawing.

Props.Name: Layer
Props.Description: The ID of the layer new items go into.

Props.Name: Toolbar
Props.Description: Shows the tools, the colors and the actions over it.

Props.Name: ReadOnly
Props.Description: Shows the drawing alone.

Props.Name: Label
Props.Description: What it shows, for screen readers.

EventDescriptions.select: The selection changed: the IDs of the items selected.

Components.Name: DrawingLayers
Components.Description: The layers of a Drawing: shown or hidden, locked, named, ordered.

Props.Name: Value
Props.Description: The model of the Drawing.

Props.Name: Layer
Props.Description: The ID of the current layer.

Props.Name: ReadOnly
Props.Description: Shows the layers without letting them change.

EventDescriptions.change: The layers changed: the model of the drawing.
EventDescriptions.select: A layer was chosen: its ID.

Components.Name: CutsceneEditor
Components.Description: An editor of the cutscenes of a Scene on a line of time: tracks, keys, titles, preview and recording.

Props.Name: Value
Props.Description: The cutscenes by name: {Name: {Tracks, Restore, Skip, Loop}}.

Props.Name: Scene
Props.Description: The Scene (the component) they play in.

Props.Name: Target
Props.Description: The object a move or a cut goes to by default.

Props.Name: Label
Props.Description: What it shows, for screen readers.

EventDescriptions.camera: Camera from view was pressed: {Props} of a camera where the view is.

Components.Name: SceneEditor
Components.Description: An editor of a game scene as Unreal edits a level: objects, kinds to add, the view with a gizmo, fields, blueprint parameters, Play.

Props.Name: Value
Props.Description: The document: {Version, Name, Setting, Scene (the recipe of Scene.Save)}.

Props.Name: Setting
Props.Description: What a new document is: a ground under a sun, or a star system.

Props.Name: Scale
Props.Description: How real the sizes and distances of a star system are: 0 readable (large bodies, nothing crowded) to 1 real, a slider over the view.

Props.Name: Kinds
Props.Description: The kinds of objects to add on a ground.

Props.Name: SpaceKinds
Props.Description: The kinds of objects to add in a star system.

Props.Name: Graphs
Props.Description: The shader graphs of a world its scene is drawn with (Graphs of Scene: shader/bake, shader/weather, shader/bolt), read as it is made.

Props.Name: Models
Props.Description: Models of the Models Service to place on a ground (an ModelEditor's), each as the kind its Type fits: a unit, a house, a tree, a rock or a thing.

Props.Name: Storage
Props.Description: The key of localStorage Save keeps the document under.

Props.Name: SnapMove
Props.Description: The step of a move with Snap, in metres.

Props.Name: SnapTurn
Props.Description: The step of a turn with Snap, in degrees.

Props.Name: SnapScale
Props.Description: The step of a scale with Snap.

Props.Name: Label
Props.Description: What it shows, for screen readers.

Components.Name: PlanetEditor
Components.Description: An editor of a planet as a globe: continents, oceans, ranges, rivers, climates and lands drawn on it, its plates, winds and climate shown sharp at any distance.

Props.Name: Value
Props.Description: The planet: the options of ScenePlanet.Make.

Props.Name: Tool
Props.Description: The tool in hand: a stroke of its Paint, a brush of its Edits (raise, lower, flatten, smooth: a drag paints along its path), a region of a rule of detail (rule), a location, or the settlements and the rivers it makes (settlements, streams: changed in its Places).

Props.Name: Overlay
Props.Description: What is shown of the planet.

Props.Name: Label
Props.Description: What it shows, for screen readers.

EventDescriptions.change: The planet changed: the options of ScenePlanet.Make.
EventDescriptions.location: A location of the planet opened: {ID, Location} (SceneLocations.Location: its World, its place, its kind).
EventDescriptions.drawn: The picture of the view is whole: {Overlay}.

Components.Name: WorldEditor
Components.Description: An editor of a whole world, level in level: a galaxy, the system of a star, a planet, a location; its models, plants, cutscenes, materials and graphs each in a tab beside it.

Props.Name: Value
Props.Description: The world: {Name, Galaxy (options of GalaxyData.Make or its data), Planets, Locations, Resources, Graphs}.

Props.Name: Generator
Props.Description: A generator of models for its models (ModelEditor): function (description, callback (error, recipe)).

Props.Name: Label
Props.Description: What it shows, for screen readers.

EventDescriptions.change: The world changed: {Name, Galaxy, Planets, Locations, Resources, Graphs}.
EventDescriptions.error: A file of a world was not read: the error.

Components.Name: ModelEditor
Components.Description: An editor of a model made of shapes: parts in pieces with tags, mirrors and variants of a seed, a gizmo, the recipe of Models and its files glb, fbx and obj.

Props.Name: Value
Props.Description: The document: {Version, Name, Recipe (a recipe of data of Models: Parts, Pieces, Group, Type, Size...)}.

Props.Name: Variant
Props.Description: The variant shown: 0, the parts as they are; the others varied by their seed.

Props.Name: Generator
Props.Description: A generator of models: function (description, callback (error, recipe)).

Props.Name: Storage
Props.Description: The key of localStorage Save keeps the document under.

Props.Name: SnapMove
Props.Description: The step of a move with Snap, in sizes of the model.

Props.Name: SnapTurn
Props.Description: The step of a turn with Snap, in degrees.

Props.Name: SnapScale
Props.Description: The step of a scale with Snap.

Props.Name: Label
Props.Description: What it shows, for screen readers.

Props.Name: Wire
Props.Description: Shows the wire of the model: each edge of its triangles.

Props.Name: Edges
Props.Description: Shows the edges of the model: where its faces meet at an angle and its rims (true).

Props.Name: Mode
Props.Description: The tab shown: the parts of the recipe (shape), the roles of the parts of a model (roles), what is done to its pieces (parts) or the graph of a model of the library (graph).

Props.Name: GraphModel
Props.Description: In the tab Graph, the model of the library whose graph is shown (OpenGraph).

Props.Name: RoleModel
Props.Description: In the tab Roles, a model of a file of SceneModels whose roles are edited (ModelRoles keeps them); empty: the one of the document (its recipe keeps them, Roles).

Components.Name: FloraEditor
Components.Description: A species of plant of a photograph of it: its trunk, crown and colors read from the picture, grown at once in 3D, each number on a slider, defined as a model.

Props.Name: Species
Props.Description: The preset it starts of.

Props.Name: Preset
Props.Description: A preset of SceneFlora given instead (an object or its JSON).

Props.Name: Variant
Props.Description: Which plant of the species the view shows (0 and up).

Props.Name: Name
Props.Description: The name of the model Define makes.

Props.Name: Label
Props.Description: What it shows, for screen readers.

EventDescriptions.define: Define made it a model of SceneModels: {Name}.

Components.Name: TextureLab
Components.Description: A bench for the textures of SceneTextures: a tile and a ground under the sun, sharp near and far, its params on sliders.

Props.Name: Texture
Props.Description: The name of the texture (SceneTextures).

Props.Name: View
Props.Description: A ground under the eye, or the tile Repeat times across.

Props.Name: Mode
Props.Description: What is shown: lit, its color, its normal or its height.

Props.Name: Params
Props.Description: The params of the recipe ({Name: value}); the others as the recipe has them.

Props.Name: Sun
Props.Description: The elevation of the sun, degrees.

Props.Name: Turn
Props.Description: The azimuth of the sun, degrees.

Props.Name: Repeat
Props.Description: Tiles across the height of the view tile (below 1: nearer than a tile, as a photograph of it).

Props.Name: Height
Props.Description: The eye over the ground in the view ground, metres.

Props.Name: Pitch
Props.Description: How far the eye looks down in the view ground, degrees.

Props.Name: Label
Props.Description: What it shows, for screen readers.

EventDescriptions.change: A texture or a param changed: {Texture, Params}.

Services.Name: Renderer
Services.Description: The graphics of three dimensions on WebGL2: a camera and a renderer of shapes with shaders.

Services.Name: Meshes
Services.Description: The shapes of three dimensions made of triangles: spheres, boxes, cylinders, lathes and the rest, moved, merged and simplified.

Services.Name: SceneKinds
Services.Description: The kinds of the objects of a game: what they extend, what they can do (Traits) and what they are made of (Parts).

Services.Name: SceneMaterials
Services.Description: The library of materials of a Scene: patterns of GLSL in metres of the world, for the ground, roads and models.

Services.Name: SceneTextures
Services.Description: Textures of materials made of code and baked once into tiles that repeat with no seam, with mipmaps and anisotropic filtering.

Services.Name: SceneShards
Services.Description: How a solid thing breaks: Voronoi cells denser near the hit, its triangles cut by them, the convex hull of each piece.

Services.Name: ScenePipes
Services.Description: Pipes of any size laid on supports, on the ground or under it: their model outside and inside, flanges and supports, what they cut out of the ground, the fluids they hold.
Methods: Blocks(pipes, x, z, y, round, heights)

Services.Name: SceneTerrainGenerator
Services.Description: The ground of a game, continuous: heights of noise anywhere, meshes in chunks, ways over it; the ground of a planet as its surface shows.
Methods: Daylight(field, x0, z0, x1, z1, low, options)

Services.Name: BlueprintShaders
Services.Description: The graphs of Blueprints made into shaders and passes of a picture: the kinds pass, material and render.

Services.Name: SceneBlueprints
Services.Description: What a Scene adds to Blueprints: the graphs of effects and the blocks of the passes of its picture.

Services.Name: Gltf
Services.Description: glTF 2.0 and GLB: meshes, materials, skins and animations of the models other programs make.

Services.Name: Fbx
Services.Description: The files of FBX, binary and text: models with meshes, materials, pictures, skins and clips, read and written.

Services.Name: ModelFormats
Services.Description: The files of models read and written in one form: glb, gltf, fbx (binary and text) and obj.

Services.Name: Sigils
Services.Description: Magic circles of a seed, as data: rings of lines, ticks, dots, arcs, runes and stars, each with a turn of its own.

Services.Name: SceneRoads
Services.Description: The roads of a scene, of any kind: motorways, streets, country roads, race tracks, paths, runways and railways, their cross-sections, lines and models.
Methods: BarrierHit(roads, x, z, fromX, fromZ, hints, size)

Services.Name: SceneRoadGenerator
Services.Description: Roads made of a seed, the same each time: closed race tracks as roads of a Scene, with where they start.

Services.Name: ModelBlueprints
Services.Description: Models made of graphs of Blueprints: parts, their places, mirrors and pieces, as a recipe of data of SceneModels.

Services.Name: CloudBlueprints
Services.Description: Clouds of points made of graphs of Blueprints: stars of a sky, swarms of clusters, rocks of belts; each point of the same graph.

Services.Name: NetworkBlueprints
Services.Description: Networks made of graphs of Blueprints: rivers, roads, rails and tracks, each step an algorithm told by its properties.

Services.Name: LayoutBlueprints
Services.Description: Layouts made of graphs of Blueprints: the streets, lots and walls of settlements, each stage an algorithm told by its properties.

Services.Name: ImageBlueprints
Services.Description: Pictures made on the processor of graphs of Blueprints: the bark and the leaves of plants, each pixel of a graph or a picture of an algorithm.

Services.Name: SceneModels
Services.Description: The models of a game made of graphs and code: units, animals, plants, buildings and ships of pieces that move, fantasy and sci-fi, and their clips.

Services.Name: SceneMannequin
Services.Description: A person made wholly of code, as detailed as a model of a file: its skin, its skeleton of Mixamo and its clips.

Services.Name: ModelRoles
Services.Description: What the parts of a model are: wheels, steering, pedals, doors, lamps, levers, hatches; kept for each model, moved by a Scene.

Services.Name: SceneBuildingGenerator
Services.Description: Buildings of any size made of their numbers, from a shack to a business centre: models of the Models Service.

Services.Name: SceneBiomes
Services.Description: The lands of a game: the colors of a ground, what grows on it, and villages laid out on it.

Services.Name: SceneWaves
Services.Description: The waves of a sea as Gerstner waves: for the shader that draws them and for what floats on them.

Services.Name: SceneShowcase
Services.Description: One big world made of every primitive of the generation of a Scene: a demo and a benchmark.

Services.Name: SceneSower
Services.Description: What the Scatter of a Scene sows in squares of a ground, worked out in workers: the same things for the same seed.

Services.Name: SceneProxies
Services.Description: What stands far away as one simpler shape: the copies of a tile merged and snapped to a grid, small things as small bodies.

Services.Name: SceneCache
Services.Description: What a scene made once kept in the browser (IndexedDB): the proxies of far tiles, the squares of a planet, the oldest gone over a limit.

Services.Name: SceneClusters
Services.Description: A level of detail of clusters, as Nanite makes one: groups of clusters made simpler level by level, their borders kept, each part drawn as fine as the screen needs.

Services.Name: SceneFlora
Services.Description: Realistic plants of code: trunks and branches grown by space colonization (whorls for spruces, fronds for palms), bark and leaves drawn of code, each plant of a species another.

Services.Name: SceneWorld
Services.Description: The world of a ground as a graph of its steps: the land, its relief, climate, biomes and sketch, and what is made on it.

Services.Name: SceneForecast
Services.Description: The weather of a planet of one source in the kernel language: its winds and storms, fronts, heaps, cirrus and rain, the same in the page and in a shader.
Methods: Air(p, days, seed, radiusKm, scale, fine, eddy, cells)
Fronts(fronts, mid, moist, ground, climb, py, storm, cloudiness, cut, cutBy, soft)
Heaps(p, sun, warm, moist, ground, climb, streams, mid, humid, storm, sheet, cloudiness, fairLow, fairHigh)
Rain(sheet, humid, storm, heaps, kind, from, to)
Shroud(sheet, heaps, kind, cirrus, rain, cloudiness)
Wind(p, days, seed, radiusKm, eddy, cells)

Services.Name: WeatherInfluences
Services.Description: What is done to the weather of a planet in a place for a while (a storm seeded, a rocket against hail, clouds seeded or dispersed, fog): data of no state over its forecast, each kind a graph, drifting with the wind, leaving others.
Methods: Apply(over, way, days, list, wind, radiusKm)

Services.Name: ScenePlanet
Services.Description: A planet as one continuous function of a direction: painted continents, tectonic plates, winds, climate and biomes, as fine as it is asked.
Methods: TileValues(options, layer, face, level, x, y, size, table)

Services.Name: PlanetData
Services.Description: A planet as data: its passport, its layers (heights, biomes, climate, plates) as tiles over a cube and its vectors (rivers, settlements, highways), baked, saved to a file, opened from one or from the network, kept in the browser.
Methods: Bytes(layer, face, level, x, y, values, type)

Services.Name: SystemData
Services.Description: A star system as data: its passport, its tree of orbits to any depth, what was changed of it and the planets of its bodies, read and written by parts.

Services.Name: GalaxyData
Services.Description: A galaxy as data: its supermassive black hole, its stars made sector by sector of its seed as many as a galaxy holds, its systems, what was changed of it.

Services.Name: UniverseData
Services.Description: A universe as data: its galaxies made of its seed cube by cube with no end, those of its author, the one one starts in, what was changed of it.

Services.Name: SceneLocations
Services.Description: The locations of a planet: cells of its surface, each a scene in detail, their neighbours, passages between them and what is past their sides.

Services.Name: SceneInteriors
Services.Description: The inside of a ship to walk in: rooms laid out by its class (cockpit, bridge, corridor, engine room, cargo, hangar) fitted into its hull, consoles for its roles, a hatch and a ramp, its legs.

Services.Name: SceneCharacters
Services.Description: The walkers of a game as data: a character a file of its own (its model, its bones, its clips or a set of them, what it holds), made a unit of a Scene.

Services.Name: SceneCars
Services.Description: The cars of a game as data: a car a file of its own (its model, its parts by their roles, how it goes, its pipes, mirrors and screens), made a unit of a Scene.

Services.Name: ViewTouch
Services.Description: The fingers on the view of an editor: one finger edits, two move the camera (pan, pinch, rotate, tilt); a toggle gives one finger to the camera.
